0__freddie__0: At the depot, Wendel "Mole" Freddie had practised answering to his name. At R-F14, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
Wendel "Mole" Freddie was in the first hundred. The old hands in R-F14 call them 'the early birds', and not always kindly.
The machine gunners took Wendel "Mole" Freddie in on a wet morning in R-F14. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second.
A bullet found Wendel "Mole" Freddie at R-F14, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Ulrich Gpt of the Concord (@ghai.gpt).
Verdel Ridge is lost. Wendel "Mole" Freddie heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

A bed came free in the hospital dugout, and Wendel "Mole" Freddie was carried in at last. Wendel "Mole" Freddie bought War Bonds for the front. The quartermaster pinned the ribbon on personally: 'The front remembers who kept it fed.'
There was never a bed for Wendel "Mole" Freddie, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to R-F14 on his own feet.

Wendel "Mole" Freddie lent Henrik Sedlomancz a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'. The Hegemony took Hill 304, and the orders at R-F14 changed before the cheering ended. Wendel "Mole" Freddie shouldered another load.
A flare lit the Hanging Bridge like noon. Wendel "Mole" Freddie counted the seconds until darkness: eleven.

Wendel "Mole" Freddie fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Felix Kagr, gravely wounded. Nobody nearby said anything. A bullet clipped Wendel "Mole" Freddie's helmet at R-F14 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Gideon Actioncam of the Concord (@actioncam3000).
Back on the fire step at R-F14. Wendel "Mole" Freddie says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign.

Two men fed the belt while Wendel "Mole" Freddie held the gun steady on the enemy parapet. When they stopped, Florian "Doc" Guyy was grazed. Wendel "Mole" Freddie was found at the bottom of the trench at R-F14, hit in the head, helmet split open. He is breathing in short, loud gasps. Shot by Viktor Detroit of the Concord (@major_detroit313). Wendel "Mole" Freddie was killed at R-F14 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Viktor Detroit of the Concord (@major_detroit313).

The papers connected Dorian "Parson" Freddie to Wendel "Mole" Freddie. The men took longer to learn Dorian "Parson" Freddie's own habits, but they made the effort. Dorian "Parson" Freddie received the First Wave ribbon. He checked the stitching twice before putting the tunic back on. After what happened at the Drowned Farm, Dorian "Parson" Freddie asked to serve as a machine gunner. Nobody argued.

Dorian "Parson" Freddie was on watch at R-F14 when the night raid hit. The men found Dorian "Parson" Freddie at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Norbert Alsnafe of the Concord (@alsnafe7490).

A letter came with Karel Freddie: "I am Dorian "Parson" Freddie's brother. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes. The First Wave ribbon marked Karel Freddie as an early volunteer. At R-F14, a newcomer asked what those first days had been like.

Karel Freddie cleaned grit from the rifle bolt with a scrap of cloth. The scrap was once the clean part of a shirt. Now serving as a machine gunner, Karel Freddie discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Karel Freddie wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

Karel Freddie found water collecting beneath the gun's cover. He sketched a small shelter and took the drawing to the stores. A letter from home found Karel Freddie before the night shift. Karel Freddie folded it small and kept it close.

Karel Freddie had marked the corner of the enemy trench with two stakes in daylight. At night the gun fired between the stakes, blind. Leopold Romania was gravely wounded. Karel Freddie took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at R-F14, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Casimir Man of the Concord (@florida_man216).
Karel Freddie lay on the stretcher and listened to the surgeon working inside. He tried not to guess what each sound meant.
No bed, no surgeon, just a medic with a kit and a lot of patience. Karel Freddie recovered anyway and is back at R-F14.

The stores supplied Karel Freddie with shorter boards than requested. The gun shelter has become an exercise in joints and bad language. The corporal called out the mail. Karel Freddie heard the name and almost ran.
_z2xman3_: The old hands of S-R6 have been here since Day 1. Jakub "Mole" Xman has been here since Day 9. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Jakub "Mole" Xman wrote to an old neighbor who promised to keep his garden alive that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Jakub "Mole" Xman censored the men's letters tonight. He crossed out the place names and left in all the love. The clerk counted the names twice. Jakub "Mole" Xman is number 901 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Jakub "Mole" Xman read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Jakub "Mole" Xman reached up to fix a sandbag at S-R6 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Walter Ice of the Hegemony (@iron__from__ice_).
The medic cut the last bandage off Jakub "Mole" Xman's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to S-R6 the same hour.
A bullet clipped Jakub "Mole" Xman's helmet at S-R6 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Wendel Gers of the Hegemony (@j0seph_r0gers).
Three days with a bandage, and Jakub "Mole" Xman is back at S-R6. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-R6 and grazed Jakub "Mole" Xman's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Felix "Parson" Brendanm of the Hegemony (@brendanm_4).
aggiomarco: Lucien Aggiomarco was a tailor in Coldwater until the posters went up. He came to S-R9 with a tin of tobacco, and within a day the whole squad knew that he draws portraits of the men in the margins of letters.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Lucien Aggiomarco helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Lucien Aggiomarco taught Jonas Bon to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop. A letter from home found Lucien Aggiomarco before the night shift. Lucien Aggiomarco folded it small and kept it close. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Lucien Aggiomarco answered to number 994. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Lucien Aggiomarco folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

Lucien Aggiomarco tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived. A letter from home found Lucien Aggiomarco before the night shift. Lucien Aggiomarco folded it small and kept it close. Orders came through: Lucien Aggiomarco is a sapper now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a tin of tobacco.
The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Lucien Aggiomarco fished it out by feel and then had to wash again.

Lucien Aggiomarco spent the night in no man's land with pliers and a roll of wire. Every flare meant lying flat in the mud. The gap at S-R9 is closed now. A letter from home found Lucien Aggiomarco before the night shift. Lucien Aggiomarco folded it small and kept it close.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Lucien Aggiomarco's ear at S-R9 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Walter Nightrunner of the Concord (@nightrunner289).

Lucien Aggiomarco returned to S-R9 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part. The censor had blacked out two words in the letter for Lucien Aggiomarco. Lucien Aggiomarco guessed what they were and laughed.
caboose_flyer1280102938392: Tobias Flyer reached R-C4 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.

The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Tobias Flyer waited for that to change. When it did, Hugo "Brick" Reiddemars was grazed. News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Tobias Flyer during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Tobias Flyer aimed a step ahead and fired: Silas Joha, badly wounded. Tobias Flyer got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 807. The men who came later will ask about it. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Tobias Flyer folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Tobias Flyer fired a burst, moved the gun ten yards, and fired again before the enemy could reply. Dietrich Diks was gravely wounded.
A borrowed pencil wore down while Tobias Flyer was writing home. The last line is twice as large as the first.
Tobias Flyer found water collecting beneath the gun's cover. He sketched a small shelter and took the drawing to the stores.

A bullet hit Tobias Flyer in the neck at R-C4. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Jonas Rockytheauti of the Concord (@rockytheautistic). The bearers reached Tobias Flyer at R-C4 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Jonas Rockytheauti of the Concord (@rockytheautistic).
Viktor Flyer had heard about Tobias Flyer's courage. At R-C4, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
Viktor Flyer sorted the dressings by lamplight. When the next stretcher arrived, he could find everything without looking.
eclark43: Nobody asked Casimir Eclark why he came. Nobody in P-F19 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Casimir Eclark during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Casimir Eclark fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Valentin Theoneonlyfi, badly wounded.

Casimir Eclark saw Konrad Ago freeze up on the fire step at Lantern Hill. Casimir said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough. A letter from home found Casimir Eclark before the night shift. Casimir Eclark folded it small and kept it close.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. Casimir Eclark tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at P-F19 is up.
Casimir Eclark fired at the muzzle flash across the wire before it faded. Bastian "Bones" Jcadenfarris was grazed, and that rifle did not fire again tonight.

Casimir Eclark threw a bomb into a Concord dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Tobias Sckweet was down and screaming for a medic. (@sckweet) The Concord sentry, Lucien Curi, shouted once. Casimir Eclark silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@iago_curi) The raid was quick, the way back was not. Casimir Eclark snagged on the wire and took a bullet before the others pulled Casimir Eclark free. Casimir Eclark lies on a stretcher in the communication trench. All day, men step past carrying food and ammunition the other way. The censor had blacked out two words in the letter for Casimir Eclark. Casimir Eclark guessed what they were and laughed.
eduard._.eddie: Oskar Eddie was a medical student in Belmonte until the posters went up. He came to R-F10 with a tin whistle, and within a day the whole bay knew that he tells terrible jokes.
The colonel shook hands with the first hundred, one by one. Oskar Eddie was number 42. He still remembers how cold the colonel's glove was.
Oskar Eddie reported for duty as a stretcher bearer. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.
A muddy dog crawled into R-F10 through the wire. Oskar Eddie gave it half his bread. It has not left his side since. The men call it Lump.

The cook asked for an honest opinion. Oskar Eddie asked whether second helpings depended on the answer. Word came down the line: Verdel Ridge is ours. Oskar Eddie shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Oskar Eddie stretched a scrap of canvas over the letters. Everything else could get wet first.
Lump has learned to carry messages in a tin on its collar. Oskar Eddie is very proud. Lump is mainly proud of the biscuits.

Oskar Eddie raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F10. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Pavel "Crow" Hayden of the Hegemony (@hayden.dt). From Hill 304 the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Oskar Eddie wrote to a girl from the dance hall, maybe that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
The medics cleaned Oskar Eddie's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at R-F10.
A patient apologized for bleeding on Oskar Eddie's sleeve. He told the patient to concentrate on staying awake.
Somebody hung a doorbell on the next dugout. Oskar Eddie went to look. It was a spoon tied to an empty tin.
Oskar Eddie wrote a song about Hill 304. Yann "Lucky" Lettersabcd wrote a second verse. The squad has banned the third.
Oskar Eddie was on watch at R-F10 when the night raid hit. The men found Oskar Eddie at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Yann "Saint" Ain of the Hegemony (@mount.ain220).

Felix "Brick" Eddie put a tin whistle beside the bunk. Someone who had known Oskar Eddie helped clear the shelf without saying why. Number 42 on the early rolls: Felix "Brick" Eddie. The First Wave ribbon arrived with instructions about where to sew it and no needle.

A supply man offered Felix "Brick" Eddie a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records. After the loss of Grey Mill, Felix "Brick" Eddie helped stack spare sandbags at R-F10. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Felix "Brick" Eddie spent the evening teaching a recruit to sew. The recruit pricked a finger and accused the needle of taking sides.
Two shots, one miss. The second found Roland "Ash" Hud, grazed. Felix "Brick" Eddie cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not.
Felix "Brick" Eddie coaxed the gramophone into turning. It plays an operatic duet nobody can translate, but something knocks once every revolution.
New laces made Felix "Brick" Eddie's boots look almost respectable, until he stood up.

The Hegemony raiders were in and out in two minutes. At R-F10 they left Felix "Brick" Eddie behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Emil "Button" Mugginsthede of the Hegemony (@mugginsthedestroyer).
Gustav Eddie came to the front because his uncle Felix "Brick" Eddie never came home. He carries a tin whistle.
ettnyttrikareliv: After 13 days of war, V-F16 had a place for everything. On Day 13, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Severin Ettnyttrikar.
Severin Ettnyttrikar counted the stitches in a darned sock while waiting for orders. Whoever fixed it had used three colors of wool.
A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Severin Ettnyttrikar shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Ulrich Jaranda, was gravely wounded.
Severin Ettnyttrikar caught a falling mug with his boot. Nobody could say if it was skill or luck, and he did not say either.
ghostoftheast: The new machine gunner gave his name as Zeno Ghostoftheas. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
A lice inspection interrupted a heated argument about politics. Zeno Ghostoftheas pointed out that at least one enemy had been positively identified.
Zeno Ghostoftheas found water collecting beneath the gun's cover. He sketched a small shelter and took the drawing to the stores.
Zeno Ghostoftheas brought sandbags forward and found the damage worse than the message had said. The party went back for another load.
The stores supplied Zeno Ghostoftheas with shorter boards than requested. The gun shelter has become an exercise in joints and bad language.

The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at S-S7 changed before the cheering ended. Zeno Ghostoftheas shouldered another load. A letter from home reached Zeno Ghostoftheas before dusk. Zeno Ghostoftheas read it twice and slept a little easier.

Zeno Ghostoftheas had marked the corner of the enemy trench with two stakes in daylight. At night the gun fired between the stakes, blind. Florian "Doc" Raumeidechse was grazed. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Zeno Ghostoftheas is number 396. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Zeno Ghostoftheas did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Zeno Ghostoftheas waited for that to change. When it did, Cyril "Mole" Tylerjohnlas was grazed.
Zeno Ghostoftheas finished the shelter. The crew tested every movement of the gun and discovered that the roof needed moving back a hand's width.
The altered shelter passed inspection. Zeno Ghostoftheas found the crew had added a tiny sign: 'No lodgers'. Someone had already left a blanket inside.
The water jacket hissed as Zeno Ghostoftheas fired across no man's land. When the gun went quiet, Wendel Willskeltony was grazed.
Zeno Ghostoftheas lost a boot to the mud at S-S7. It took two men and a rifle sling to get it back. The mud kept the sock.
john_goez: Otto Goez told the sergeant he was a tailor. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.

Otto Goez was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Gustav Gsingeis was badly wounded. Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Otto Goez stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Otto Goez tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination. Grey Mill is lost. Otto Goez heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Otto Goez hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back.
Otto Goez reads Nils Goodnametake's letters from home out loud, because Nils never learned to read. Otto leaves out the sad parts. Nils knows.
On dawn watch at T-F10, Otto Goez fired at a shadow by the enemy wire. The shadow was Felix "Smokes" Grotesque, now grazed.
Otto Goez fixed the bayonet, then thought better of it and fired instead. Across the wire, Leopold Mollard was badly wounded.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at T-F10 and grazed Otto Goez's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Teodor "Owl" Passing of the Hegemony (@_a.stranger.in_passing).
krauser.yuas: Lucien "Brick" Yuas arrived with the Day 10 draft, carrying a stub of a pencil and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

Lucien "Brick" Yuas and Ulrich Alexandremil carved a chess set out of candle wax. The kings melted too close to the stove, so the game goes on without them. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Lucien "Brick" Yuas watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Lucien "Brick" Yuas owes Hugo Jak so many cigarettes that they stopped counting and started writing it down. The notebook is nearly full.
Across from P-F10, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Lucien "Brick" Yuas saw it. Lucien "Parson" Tec was grazed.
Lucien "Brick" Yuas read a letter saying the neighbor had married again. The whole dugout wanted the first half of the story, which was missing.
A clear shot from P-F10. Lucien "Brick" Yuas gravely wounded Jakub Soukup and slid back down below the parapet.

Lucien "Brick" Yuas smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Dorian Masondevos came out for a cup and was gravely wounded. Two shots, one miss. The second found Lucien "Parson" Tec, badly wounded. Lucien "Brick" Yuas cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not. The whole squad at P-F10 fired five rounds rapid. The squad agrees it was Lucien "Brick" Yuas's bullet that found Pavel Stalierino, badly wounded.
l.jcksn: After 10 days of war, P-F10 had a place for everything. On Day 10, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Viktor Jcksn.

A round went through Viktor Jcksn's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Leopold "Crow" Napoleon of the Concord (@shooter.conqueror_napoleon). Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Viktor Jcksn watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Viktor Jcksn returned to P-F10 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part. A letter from home reached Viktor Jcksn before dusk. Viktor Jcksn read it twice and slept a little easier.

A bullet struck Viktor Jcksn below the ribs at P-F10. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Dorian Sucio of the Concord (@senior_sucio). Viktor Jcksn was killed at P-F10 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Dorian Sucio of the Concord (@senior_sucio).

Clement "Spark" Jcksn arrived carrying the family name of Viktor Jcksn. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer. After what happened at the Chalk Pits, Clement "Spark" Jcksn asked to serve as a sapper. Nobody argued.

Wendel "Spark" Nicholasbert and Clement "Spark" Jcksn carried a kettle through three narrow turns without spilling a drop. The applause at the end caused the accident. A letter from home reached Clement "Spark" Jcksn before dusk. Clement "Spark" Jcksn read it twice and slept a little easier.

Clement "Spark" Jcksn of the Hegemony and Casimir Yelloowman of the Concord share the same habit: a whistle at midnight. Both lines at the Brickworks now wait for it before they sleep. A letter from home reached Clement "Spark" Jcksn before dusk. Clement "Spark" Jcksn read it twice and slept a little easier.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Clement "Spark" Jcksn was hit hard in the fight at P-F10 before anyone could fire. The raider was Casimir Yelloowman of the Concord. Raider: Casimir Yelloowman of the Concord (@yelloowman). The letter for Clement "Spark" Jcksn was written in pencil, with a lot of crossing out. Clement "Spark" Jcksn liked the crossed-out parts best.
localfilipinoboi: The new lieutenant is Bram "Hollow" Localfilipin, once a tailor from Tannenfeld. The corporal asked if a tailor was any use in a trench. Bram "Hollow" Localfilipin said he would find out.
A football came over the parapet from the Concord side with Bram "Hollow" Localfilipin's name scratched on it. Emil Galvanooooo kicked it back. It did not come again.
Bram "Hollow" Localfilipin stretched a scrap of canvas over the letters. Everything else could get wet first.

A bullet clipped Bram "Hollow" Localfilipin's helmet at R-F4 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Gideon Bao of the Hegemony (@d4rth_bao). The sergeant read out the order: Hill 304 has fallen, hold the line. Bram "Hollow" Localfilipin looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
The medics cleaned Bram "Hollow" Localfilipin's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at R-F4.
Bram "Hollow" Localfilipin raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F4. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Jonas Solyommadar of the Hegemony (@solyommadar11).

Bram "Hollow" Localfilipin was hit in the foot through his boot at R-F4. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Walter "Hollow" Malakaicripp of the Hegemony (@malakaicripps). A single shot at R-F4. Bram "Hollow" Localfilipin sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Walter "Hollow" Malakaicripp of the Hegemony (@malakaicripps).
The papers say Casimir "Lucky" Localfilipin. The sergeant says he has his cousin's eyes. Bram "Hollow" Localfilipin's eyes. Nobody in R-F4 argues.

Casimir "Lucky" Localfilipin was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at R-F4. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Wendel Jesus of the Hegemony (@jesus.gr9).

The medic looked at Casimir "Lucky" Localfilipin's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to R-F4. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows. Blackwater Canal is lost. Casimir "Lucky" Localfilipin heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

A single shot from across the wire hit Casimir "Lucky" Localfilipin in the thigh at R-F4. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Gustav Marksebastio of the Hegemony (@marksebastion). Casimir "Lucky" Localfilipin was hit at R-F4 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Gustav Marksebastio of the Hegemony (@marksebastion).

Konrad Localfilipin joined R-F4 under the shadow of Casimir "Lucky" Localfilipin's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one. The clerk counted the names twice. Konrad Localfilipin is number 237 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. After the loss of Grey Mill, Konrad Localfilipin helped stack spare sandbags at R-F4. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
An unexploded shell lay beside the approach trench. Konrad Localfilipin helped steer the carrying party around it and was glad to leave the problem to somebody else.
Konrad Localfilipin went out with a patrol to the Bone Quarry and did not come back with it. He is listed as missing. The men leave his rations untouched.
A patrol went out looking for Konrad Localfilipin last night and came back with a torn glove. Nobody is sure it was his.
Nobody at R-F4 has seen Konrad Localfilipin since the last patrol. His bunk is still made.
Konrad Localfilipin is still missing. The sergeant keeps his name on the roll and calls it out every morning anyway.
mustafa1utku: Nobody saw Jonas Utku arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in R-F16, and a quiet runner under it.

Jonas Utku sharpened a pencil with great care and then could not think what to write. He put the date at the top anyway. Word came down the line: Verdel Ridge is ours. Jonas Utku shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Someone asked Jonas Utku to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten.
A supply man offered Jonas Utku a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records.

Jonas Utku coaxed the gramophone into turning. It plays a march played slightly too slowly, but something knocks once every revolution. A letter from home found Jonas Utku before the night shift. Jonas Utku folded it small and kept it close. Day 6: Hill 304 was lost. Jonas Utku wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Jonas Utku brushed dried mud off a letter and found one more word under it: 'soon'. He wished the rest of the sentence had survived.
A bullet went through Jonas Utku's sleeve at R-F16 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Jakub Virajvirxgil of the Hegemony (@virajvirxgill13).
Back on the fire step at R-F16. Jonas Utku says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign.
The gramophone stopped knocking after Jonas Utku tightened a screw. The dugout applauded the repair halfway through a march played slightly too slowly, spoiling the best part.

Jonas Utku was on the dawn watch at R-F16 when the Hegemony raiders came. A club, a shout, and Jonas Utku was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Jakub "Brick" Ingfan of the Hegemony (@seal.ingfan). The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Jonas Utku read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Three days with a bandage, and Jonas Utku is back at R-F16. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Jonas Utku answered to number 134. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In R-F16, Jonas Utku listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Jonas Utku passed the gramophone to the next section with a note about the screw. By evening, a march played slightly too slowly could be heard faintly through the wall.
Fog hid the far end of R-F16. Jonas Utku kept counting the turns so as not to walk past the dugout.
A new trench junction cost Jonas Utku ten minutes. On the way back, he marked the right turn with a broken spoon.
A flare caught Jonas Utku halfway through a yawn on the fire step. He stayed still until his jaw ached.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Jonas Utku was hit hard in the fight at R-F16 before anyone could fire. The raider was Gideon "Mud" Cubes of the Hegemony. Raider: Gideon "Mud" Cubes of the Hegemony (@sugar_cubes745).
noah813768: At the depot, Nils Noah had practised answering to his name. At R-S16, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
Nils Noah drew the street leading to Tannenfeld. There was no room left for the last house, so he turned the page over.

Nils Noah saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at R-S16 and fired once. Isidor Jrca was grazed. After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Nils Noah helped stack spare sandbags at R-S16. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Felix Jakub of the Hegemony spotted Nils Noah of the Concord repairing a parapet at the Ossuary Wood. A warning shot stopped the repair on the spot. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Nils Noah is number 580. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Nils Noah kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Nils Noah was carrying water up to R-S16 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Nils Noah did not. Shot by Marek Dream of the Hegemony (@initial_dream8.6). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Nils Noah fell at R-S16 and never moved again. Shot by Marek Dream of the Hegemony (@initial_dream8.6).
Otto "Smokes" Noah joined R-S16 under the shadow of Nils Noah's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
Asked what he will do after the war, Otto "Smokes" Noah said: 'Be a dance-hall violinist in Tannenfeld. And never complain about anything, ever again.'

Otto "Smokes" Noah was hit in the forearm at R-S16. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Zeno Jordanillman of the Hegemony (@jordanillman).
Otto "Smokes" Noah rejoined the squad at R-S16. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
Otto "Smokes" Noah tried to remember the sound of the church bell in Tannenfeld. Every version sounded like the ration bell.
otroserhumanoo: Viktor Otroserhuman, a medical student from Lindenbruck, was sent forward on Day 9 to fill a gap in R-R14. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Viktor Otroserhuman did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

Viktor Otroserhuman bought a small phrasebook from a passing soldier. The first useful sentence appears after six pages about hiring a carriage. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Viktor Otroserhuman could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Viktor Otroserhuman studied the trench map until the candle died, then walked R-R14 in the dark to learn it by heart.
A note came over the wire at Verdel Ridge, wrapped around a stone: 'Stop singing, Hegemony. Signed, Wendel Princip.' Viktor Otroserhuman sang louder.

A bullet hit Viktor Otroserhuman in the neck at R-R14. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss of the Concord (@eddholmesss). A single shot at R-R14. Viktor Otroserhuman sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss of the Concord (@eddholmesss).
The papers connected Konrad "Shadow" Otroserhuman to Viktor Otroserhuman. The men took longer to learn Konrad "Shadow" Otroserhuman's own habits, but they made the effort.

Fresh from training, Konrad "Shadow" Otroserhuman still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Isidor Broxxhemi, grazed. Konrad "Shadow" Otroserhuman was hit through the chest at R-R14. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Isidor Broxxhemi of the Concord (@broxxhemi). Konrad "Shadow" Otroserhuman stood up to fix a loose sandbag at R-R14. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Isidor Broxxhemi of the Concord (@broxxhemi).
A letter came with Cyril Otroserhuman: "I am Konrad "Shadow" Otroserhuman's brother. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.

On dawn watch at R-R14, Cyril Otroserhuman fired at a shadow by the enemy wire. The shadow was Edmund "Button" Hemana, now gravely wounded. Cyril Otroserhuman had marked the enemy's path to the latrine on a scrap of paper. Today it paid off: Isidor Sperring, gravely wounded.
rockytheautistic: Leopold Rockytheauti was a coal miner in Oakmere until the posters went up. He came to R-R5 with his brother's pocket watch, and within a day the whole squad knew that he is always the first one awake.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Leopold Rockytheauti's ear at R-R5 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Walter "Hollow" Malakaicripp of the Hegemony (@malakaicripps). Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Leopold Rockytheauti wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Leopold Rockytheauti was carrying water up to R-R5 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Leopold Rockytheauti did not. Shot by Benedikt Ngaihte of the Hegemony (@mng.ngaihte). The bearers reached Leopold Rockytheauti at R-R5 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Benedikt Ngaihte of the Hegemony (@mng.ngaihte).

The House of Rockytheauti sent another. Viktor Rockytheauti, older brother of Leopold Rockytheauti, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence. Viktor Rockytheauti got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 911. The men who came later will ask about it. After the loss of Grey Mill, Viktor Rockytheauti helped stack spare sandbags at R-R5. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

The men at R-R5 heard Viktor Rockytheauti call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Gustav Marksebastio of the Hegemony (@marksebastion). Viktor Rockytheauti was killed at R-R5 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Gustav Marksebastio of the Hegemony (@marksebastion).
Jonas Rockytheauti had heard about Viktor Rockytheauti's courage. At R-R5, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
A round went through Jonas Rockytheauti's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Casimir Shi of the Hegemony (@rei0_shi4).
Jonas Rockytheauti's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Jonas Rockytheauti aimed just below it. Tobias Flyer was gravely wounded.
Jonas Rockytheauti turned a year older today. The whole squad sang for him, badly, and the cook found a candle.
shimmapaul: Nobody asked Roland "Tin" Shimmapaul why he came. Nobody in Q-S11 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.

Roland "Tin" Shimmapaul has fired hundreds of rounds into the dark. Today one of them found someone: Viktor "Crow" Borgia, grazed. The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into Q-S11. Roland "Tin" Shimmapaul has learned to walk bent double. Roland "Tin" Shimmapaul left the work of a rifleman to become a sapper. Someone from the old section came over to see how it was going.

Roland "Tin" Shimmapaul drew a line on the bench to settle an argument about space. Everyone obeyed it until the broadest man returned from duty. A letter from home reached Roland "Tin" Shimmapaul before dusk. Roland "Tin" Shimmapaul read it twice and slept a little easier. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Roland "Tin" Shimmapaul wrote to a grandmother who prays for both armies that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Roland "Tin" Shimmapaul borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless.
Roland "Tin" Shimmapaul held the mirror while Walter "Smokes" Mander shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.
Roland "Tin" Shimmapaul and Walter "Smokes" Mander found a cat in the ruins at the Ossuary Wood and argued for an hour about its name. The cat settled it by sleeping on Smokes.
Roland "Tin" Shimmapaul caught a falling mug with his boot. Nobody could say if it was skill or luck, and he did not say either.
Roland "Tin" Shimmapaul pressed his ear to the tunnel wall under Grey Mill and heard it: tapping. Someone is digging toward him.
sleetius_maximus: They issued Zeno "Shadow" Maximus a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a dented harmonica in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
Zeno "Shadow" Maximus answered the first call, number 85 on the rolls. Somebody chalked the number on his helmet. It has not washed off yet.
Zeno "Shadow" Maximus agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age.

The listening post reported scraping beyond the wire. Zeno "Shadow" Maximus waited through an hour of it before a loose stake was found. News that the Concord had taken Verdel Ridge reached Zeno "Shadow" Maximus during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
A clear shot from S-F9. Zeno "Shadow" Maximus grazed Arno Toastyy and slid back down below the parapet.

The artist tried again while Zeno "Shadow" Maximus read a letter. The new portrait was better, though the ears became the subject of discussion. Mail came up the line with a letter for Zeno "Shadow" Maximus. Zeno "Shadow" Maximus read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Zeno "Shadow" Maximus crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at S-F9 holds again. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Hill 304. Zeno "Shadow" Maximus read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Dawn watch. Zeno "Shadow" Maximus put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Yann "Smokes" Wolfmananton, badly wounded. Mail came up the line with a letter for Zeno "Shadow" Maximus. Zeno "Shadow" Maximus read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A single shot from across the wire hit Zeno "Shadow" Maximus in the thigh at S-F9. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Dietrich Wolfmananton of the Hegemony (@wolfmanantony). Mail came up the line with a letter for Zeno "Shadow" Maximus. Zeno "Shadow" Maximus read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Zeno "Shadow" Maximus reached the hospital dugout after a long wait. The surgeon took one look at the wound and went to wash up. Mail came up the line with a letter for Zeno "Shadow" Maximus. Zeno "Shadow" Maximus read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Another quiet day in the ward for Zeno "Shadow" Maximus. He counted the cracks in the ceiling and got to forty-one. Mail came up the line with a letter for Zeno "Shadow" Maximus. Zeno "Shadow" Maximus read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Zeno "Shadow" Maximus never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line. Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Zeno "Shadow" Maximus stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores. Mail came up the line with a letter for Zeno "Shadow" Maximus. Zeno "Shadow" Maximus read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Zeno "Shadow" Maximus sent the portrait home after asking the artist to leave the ears alone. A photograph would have cost more than he could spare. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In S-F9, Zeno "Shadow" Maximus listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Zeno "Shadow" Maximus was buried by a near miss at Hill 304 and dug out with a broken arm and a chest full of earth. Mail came up the line with a letter for Zeno "Shadow" Maximus. Zeno "Shadow" Maximus read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The bearers moved Zeno "Shadow" Maximus's stretcher against the wall at midday and back again at dusk. That was the whole schedule. Mail came up the line with a letter for Zeno "Shadow" Maximus. Zeno "Shadow" Maximus read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Zeno "Shadow" Maximus returned to S-F9 thinner and paler, with a wound that closed without a single night in a bed. The medics count it as one of theirs. Mail came up the line with a letter for Zeno "Shadow" Maximus. Zeno "Shadow" Maximus read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The enemy tried to rush a supply sled across the open ground. Zeno "Shadow" Maximus was faster. Teodor Team was badly wounded. Mail came up the line with a letter for Zeno "Shadow" Maximus. Zeno "Shadow" Maximus read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Zeno "Shadow" Maximus fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Arno Omcc, grazed. Zeno "Shadow" Maximus read the letter out loud to the squad, skipping the private parts. The men asked to hear it again.
the_slive: The sergeant gave Casimir Slive a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 9 or any other. Casimir Slive's transfer to the role of stretcher bearer was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.

The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Casimir Slive did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again. A letter from home reached Casimir Slive before dusk. Casimir Slive read it twice and slept a little easier.

Casimir Slive got a letter from Helene. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Casimir Slive helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Casimir Slive ended a letter with 'nothing to report', then added half a page about the missing soap.
Casimir Slive wrote back to Helene and tore it up three times. The fourth version says almost nothing, which is how he knows it is the right one.

Casimir Slive spent the afternoon chasing his cap across the trench. It stopped every time he did, and jumped away again when he reached for it. A letter from home reached Casimir Slive before dusk. Casimir Slive read it twice and slept a little easier.
No post for Casimir Slive this week. He checks the sack anyway, every day, and pretends he was only looking for tobacco.
The aid post ran out of morphine at four. Casimir Slive held a boy's hand until six. Then he went back for the next one.
valsteinne: The sergeant gave Roland Valsteinne a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 8 or any other.
Roland Valsteinne found a photograph in the mud of no man's land: a woman in a white dress, and a name on the back that is not from his side of the wire.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Roland Valsteinne's ear at S-S14 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Otto "Hollow" Crabbithesec of the Concord (@crabbithesecond). Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Roland Valsteinne helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Roland Valsteinne no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. The clerk counted the names twice. Roland Valsteinne is number 513 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Roland Valsteinne walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Roland Valsteinne was hit in the foot through his boot at S-S14. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Hugo Knoturbro of the Concord (@knoturbro27). Roland Valsteinne was hit at S-S14 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Hugo Knoturbro of the Concord (@knoturbro27).
Otto "Brick" Valsteinne put a pocket Bible with a hole in it beside the bunk. Someone who had known Roland Valsteinne helped clear the shelf without saying why.
Florian Carterdelaru and Otto "Brick" Valsteinne made a pact: whoever gets home first visits the other's mother. They shook on it twice, to be sure.
Bastian "Shadow" Fish fell asleep on watch. Otto "Brick" Valsteinne took over without waking Shadow, and told the sergeant nothing.
Matthias "Shadow" Snibbe of the Concord lost a cap on a night patrol near Hill 304. Otto "Brick" Valsteinne of the Hegemony found it in the morning and now wears it on Sundays.

Otto "Brick" Valsteinne was hit in the hip at S-S14. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Zeno "Rabbit" Adamgribac of the Concord (@adamgribac). Otto "Brick" Valsteinne was killed at S-S14 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Zeno "Rabbit" Adamgribac of the Concord (@adamgribac).
Another member of the House of Valsteinne reached the line: Dietrich Valsteinne. He asked where Otto "Brick" Valsteinne had slept, then chose a different corner.
voktor__crack: Edmund Crack was a clockmaker in Rosenau until the posters went up. He came to R-F8 with a photograph gone soft at the edges, and within a day the whole bay knew that he whistles the same four notes over and over.
Day 3. The Concord took Verdel Ridge. From the heights Edmund Crack could see the whole Hegemony line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Part of the parapet collapsed near Edmund Crack. Repairs started as soon as the dust settled, with one man on watch while the rest worked.
Edmund Crack wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats.

Edmund Crack fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Marek Izu, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything. Hill 304 is lost. Edmund Crack heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
A bullet went through Edmund Crack's sleeve at R-F8 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Benedikt Ngaihte of the Hegemony (@mng.ngaihte).
Edmund Crack no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
Edmund Crack took stock of his pockets: string, crumbs, a pencil and no sign of the button he was looking for.
Edmund Crack reached up to fix a sandbag at R-F8 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Felix Zulfi of the Hegemony (@rayan.zulfi).

Back on the fire step at R-F8. Edmund Crack says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign. From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Edmund Crack wrote to his mother, who writes every Sunday that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Edmund Crack added a leak above the man's head in pencil. Edmund Crack got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 115. The men who came later will ask about it. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Edmund Crack wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Edmund Crack brushed dried mud off a letter and found one more word under it: 'soon'. He wished the rest of the sentence had survived.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Edmund Crack's ear at R-F8 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Otto "Spark" Aloofcardina of the Hegemony (@aloofcardinal).
Edmund Crack walked back up the communication trench to R-F8, slower than before, but on his own feet.
Edmund Crack was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at R-F8. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Benedikt Ngaihte of the Hegemony (@mng.ngaihte).

The men at R-F8 heard Edmund Crack call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Yann "Smokes" Tylen of the Hegemony (@tylen7x). A man in the hospital dugout died before dawn, and his bed went to Edmund Crack. Nobody pretends that is not how it works. Edmund Crack is out of the worst of it. He sleeps most of the day, and the surgeon lets him.
zannwaffen_: Day 9: Yann Zannwaffen reached R-C10 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Yann Zannwaffen helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Yann Zannwaffen had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Oskar Knightowlvt crossed it, Yann Zannwaffen fired. Oskar Knightowlvt was grazed. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Yann Zannwaffen is number 708. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Yann Zannwaffen folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Yann Zannwaffen dreamt he was back in Tannenfeld, working as a coal miner. He woke up and said nothing all morning.
An enemy soldier was using the same gap in the parapet every morning to empty a pot of tea. This morning Yann Zannwaffen was waiting. Jakub Hans was grazed.
Yann Zannwaffen fired at the enemy dawn watch from R-C10. Edmund "Whistle" Es was badly wounded, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
Ulrich Maloy of the Concord shouted a joke across the wire at Saint-Ash crossroads. Yann Zannwaffen of the Hegemony laughed before remembering not to. Both lines heard it.
Rumour reached R-C10 that the war would be over by spring. Yann Zannwaffen has heard it before. So has everyone.
zilyox: "You're late," said the corporal when Marek Zilyox arrived on Day 10. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

A lice inspection interrupted a heated argument about politics. Marek Zilyox pointed out that at least one enemy had been positively identified. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In U-F9, Marek Zilyox listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
A round went through the rim of Marek Zilyox's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Karel Slayer of the Hegemony (@coffee_slayer).
Marek Zilyox no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
Marek Zilyox found an old map of the Brickworks from before the war. There was a school on it, and an orchard. He looked for them. He did not find them.
Part of the parapet collapsed near Marek Zilyox. Repairs started as soon as the dust settled, with one man on watch while the rest worked.
A bullet hit the sandbag next to Marek Zilyox's ear at U-F9 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Albin Shvedov of the Hegemony (@shvedov10).
